theorems.name: Submission.polyhedral_approx_finite_smooth_ext
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν₁ ν₂ : Measure (Eucl P)), IsFiniteMeasure ν₁ → IsFiniteMeasure ν₂ → ∀ O : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen O → (∀ ψ : Eucl P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → tsupport ψ ⊆ O → ∫ x, ψ x ∂ν₁ = ∫ x, ψ x ∂ν₂) → ∀ b : Eucl P → ℝ, (∀ x, x ∉ O → b x = 0) → ∫ x, b x ∂ν₁ = ∫ x, b x ∂ν₂
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
